calls.title: GrowthBook <> Brightscout Weekly Call
calls.summary: The team successfully launched the new website on Webflow, with a strong emphasis on ensuring SEO alignment through a refined sitemap and the implementation of noindex tags on certain template pages. Redirects were prepared but inactive until confirmation on Ghost CMS to prevent broken links. Form functionalities for user engagement were tested, revealing issues with confirmation emails that require workflow setup. Critical styling and performance issues were flagged, necessitating urgent fixes, while engagement metrics showed successful lead generation from webinars. Future coordination includes calls for styling fixes and discussions around ongoing development support following the Bright Scout partnership.
